_comment: Tile manifest: the single source of truth for every Evidence Board Tile, in demo order. Tables and chart queries may only touch staging, features or ml (board/manifest.py rejects anything else). Only the Opening can land in this slice: 1A-2D use the deferred readiness rule, and their chart queries and 'proves' lines are placeholders, until their tickets (#94-#96) define them. Event matchers map recorded hook events (bin/event_recorder.py) to a Tile's activity: 'lane' (one lane per label) or 'blocked' (a guardrail deny); 'tool' must match the whole tool name and 'summary' is searched.

tiles.title: The Northeast Spike

query: DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(feed_date, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end,
AND feed_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-06' AND DATE '2026-10-31'

tiles.proves: Northeast flu-positive counts rose {wow_pct:+.0f}% in the week ending on the Cutoff, in raw counts: the Spike the agents must explain.
tiles.proves_fallback: Northeast flu-positive counts jumped in the week ending on the Cutoff, in raw counts: the Spike the agents must explain.

tiles.title: Where the Spike lives
tiles.proves: The Spike is concentrated in specific Northeast hospitals in the week ending on the Cutoff, not spread evenly across the region.

tiles.title: Attribution of the Spike
tiles.proves: Four causes (Pipeline Defect, Sampling Artifact, Outbreak and Seasonal Ramp) sum to the Spike, and the stats-reviewer challenged the Attribution.

tiles.title: The Pipeline Defect removed
tiles.proves: Deduplicating the Hospital Feeds removes the duplicate rows behind the Pipeline Defect.

tiles.title: Hospital Cohorts
tiles.proves: K-means groups hospitals into Cohorts with shared seasonal shape, isolating the Outbreak hospitals.

tiles.title: WAPE leaderboard
tiles.proves: Forecasts trained on clean data beat forecasts trained on uncleaned data on WAPE.

tiles.title: The Reveal
tiles.proves: Against the six withheld weeks after the Cutoff, the clean-data forecast tracks the truth more closely.

tiles.title: Next-period refresh
tiles.proves: The team skill reruns the whole forecasting workflow for the next epidemiological period.
